No later sale, ownership transfer or signed pending exit was identified through August 18, 2026.

beforeImage.name: Fatbeam
beforeImage.description: Fatbeam is a fiber-network operator providing connectivity, transport, and related services to commercial, education, government, carrier, and residential customers. The business is infrastructure-led and asset-heavy because it owns and operates the underlying fiber network rather than acting solely as a reseller. Company materials describe a network footprint across eight western states and more than 150 cities, while sponsor materials previously referenced 1,250 route miles at the time of Basalt's acquisition. Its operating geography includes Washington, Oregon, Montana, Arizona, New Mexico, Idaho, Wyoming, and Nevada. The company was established in 2010 and has expanded its network reach through organic buildout and acquisitions. Basalt acquired Fatbeam from SDC Capital Partners and the company's founders in 2023, and public sources do not disclose the resulting ownership percentage.

afterImage.name: Fatbeam
afterImage.description: Fatbeam is a Coeur d'Alene, Idaho-based owner-operator of fiber networks serving commercial, education, healthcare, government, carrier, tower, residential and multifamily customers across Arizona, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Washington and Wyoming. Its services include dedicated internet access, Ethernet private line, wavelength, dark fiber, wireless backup, tower and data-center connectivity, managed Wi-Fi, cyber/cloud and residential fiber/wireless. Fatbeam's current network page reports 1,600+ on-net buildings, 150,000+ total fiber miles and 150+ cities across eight states; Basalt's current portfolio page reports 1,250 route miles. A June 2023 regulator filing separately reported 1,252 route miles, 13 metro markets, 128,000+ strand miles and over 40 cities. Basalt IV announced an agreement to acquire Fatbeam on March 27, 2023, and Project Lighthouse AIV Feeder LP acquired all Fatbeam Holdings interests effective May 31, 2023. Fatbeam remains in Basalt's current portfolio, and no later ownership transfer or signed pending exit was identified through August 18, 2026.
